**Analysis:**

The payment amount (6,000,000 paise) exactly matches both candidate invoices. However, the customer_id (CUST00169) matches both INV-00198 and INV-00199. Since the payment was captured on 2026-09-15:
- INV-00198 was issued 2026-09-09 (6 days before payment)
- INV-00199 was issued 2026-09-10 (5 days before payment)

1. The amount exactly matches a single invoice
2. The customer ID matches exactly
